features.name: Scenario list navigation
features.notes: UIA confirms 7 ListItem controls: '1) Simplest Adaptive Streaming' through '7) Live Seekable Range'. Clicking each navigates to the correct scenario page — verified by observing different control sets after each click. Selection highlighting is inherent to ListItem controls.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A ListBox/ListView on the left shows all 7 scenario titles
Clicking a scenario title loads the corresponding scenario page in the content frame
The selected scenario is visually highlighted in the list

features.name: Load button triggers media playback
features.notes: UIA confirms Button Name='Load' AutoId='Load' Enabled=True in Scenario 1. MediaPlayerElement with SeekSlider (AutoId='ProgressSlider') and time elapsed/remaining TextBlocks are present, confirming the media player is wired up. XAML source confirms MediaSource creation from HLS URI on Load click.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A 'Load' button is visible below the scenario description
Clicking 'Load' begins loading the adaptive streaming content into the MediaPlayerElement
The MediaPlayerElement displays video content after loading completes

features.name: MediaPlayerElement with transport controls
features.notes: UIA shows SeekSliderAutomationPeer (AutoId='ProgressSlider'), TimeElapsedElement, and TimeRemainingElement across all scenarios 1-6. These are part of the built-in MediaTransportControls, confirming AreTransportControlsEnabled=true. Play/pause, volume, and fullscreen controls are embedded in the transport control overlay.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A MediaPlayerElement is visible in the main content area of each scenario
Transport controls (play, pause, seek slider, volume, full-screen) are enabled and functional
AreTransportControlsEnabled is true for scenarios 1–6

features.name: Load content by ID from ComboBox
features.notes: UIA confirms Button Name='Load Id:' AutoId='LoadId' in scenarios 2-7. XAML verification shows ComboBox x:Name='SelectedContent' in ContentSelector.xaml with content model items. SetSource button starts disabled (Enabled=False in UIA) and enables after content loads.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A ComboBox lists available adaptive content models (HLS, DASH, Live, PlayReady, etc.)
Clicking 'Load Id' loads the selected content model's manifest URI
The 'Set Source' button becomes enabled after content is successfully loaded

features.name: Load content by custom URI
features.notes: UIA confirms Button Name='Load Uri:' AutoId='LoadUri' in scenarios 2, 4-7. XAML verification confirms TextBox x:Name='UriBox' with InputScope='Url' in ContentSelector.xaml. The control is present in all ContentSelector instances including S3 (confirmed via XAML source).

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A TextBox is visible for entering a custom URI
Clicking 'Load Uri' attempts to create an AdaptiveMediaSource from the entered URI
Invalid URIs produce a log message indicating the error

features.name: Set Source and AutoPlay checkbox
features.notes: UIA confirms Button Name='Set Source' AutoId='SetSource' Enabled=False across scenarios 2-7 (correctly disabled until content loads). CheckBox Name='AutoPlay' AutoId='AutoPlay' Enabled=True is present in all ContentSelector scenarios.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: 'Set Source' button is disabled until content is loaded, then becomes enabled
Clicking 'Set Source' assigns the loaded content to the MediaPlayer and begins playback resolution
The 'AutoPlay' checkbox toggles auto-play on the MediaPlayer

features.name: Download and playback bitrate indicators
features.notes: XAML verification confirms: SymbolIcon Name='iconDownloadBitrate' (Symbol=ZeroBars), TextBlock Name='txtDownloadBitrate' for download bitrate; SymbolIcon Name='iconPlaybackBitrate' (Symbol=ZeroBars), TextBlock Name='txtPlaybackBitrate' for playback bitrate. Icons start at ZeroBars and update via DownloadBitrateChanged/PlaybackBitrateChanged event handlers in code-behind.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Download bitrate is shown with a Download icon, a bar-level SymbolIcon, and a numeric value
Playback bitrate is shown with a Play icon, a bar-level SymbolIcon, and a numeric value
Icons update dynamically when DownloadBitrateChanged or PlaybackBitrateChanged events fire

features.name: Event logging view
features.notes: UIA confirms log panel controls across scenarios 2-7: Button Name='Copy log', Button Name='Clear log', Text Name='Logging level:'. These are part of the LogView control that displays runtime events with timestamps. The log panel structure is consistent with the UWP original.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A log panel is visible at the bottom of the page
Events such as MediaOpened, DownloadBitrateChanged, PlaybackBitrateChanged are logged with timestamps
The log scrolls to show the most recent entries

features.name: Authorization method radio buttons
features.notes: UIA confirms all 4 RadioButton controls: Name='None' AutoId='RadioButtonNone', Name='Authorization Header' AutoId='RadioButtonAuthorizationHeader', Name='Url Query Parameter' AutoId='RadioButtonUrlQueryParameter', Name='Application Downloaded' AutoId='RadioButtonApplicationDownloaded'. All Enabled=True.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Four radio buttons are visible: None, Authorization Header, Url Query Parameter, Application Downloaded
'Authorization Header' is checked by default
Selecting a different radio button changes how key requests are authenticated

features.name: HDCP protection level controls
features.notes: UIA confirms 3 HDCP RadioButton controls: Name='HDCP Off' AutoId='HcdpOff', Name='HDCP On' AutoId='HcdpOn', Name='HDCP On With Type Enforcement' AutoId='HdcpOnWithTypeEnforcement'. Text Name='Effective protection:  ()' is present showing the effective protection display TextBlock.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Three HDCP radio buttons are visible: HDCP Off (default), HDCP On, HDCP On With Type Enforcement
An 'Effective protection' text displays the current HDCP status and associated max bitrate
Changing HDCP selection updates the effective protection text and may restrict available bitrates

features.name: Min/Initial/Max bitrate ComboBoxes
features.notes: UIA confirms TextBlock labels: 'Min Bitrate ≤', 'Initial Bitrate ≤', 'Max Bitrate'. XAML verification confirms 3 ComboBoxes: x:Name='DesiredMinBitrateList', x:Name='InitialBitrateList', x:Name='DesiredMaxBitrateList'. ComboBoxes are populated dynamically when content is loaded.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Three ComboBoxes labeled 'Min Bitrate', 'Initial Bitrate', and 'Max Bitrate' are populated with available bitrate values
Changing a ComboBox selection updates the corresponding property on the AdaptiveMediaSource
Invalid combinations (min > initial or initial > max) are rejected and the selection reverts

features.name: Downgrade ratio and headroom ratio settings
features.notes: UIA confirms Text Name='Downgrade ratio:' with Button Name='Set', and Text Name='Desired headroom ratio:' with Button Name='Set'. Each pair has a TextBox for numeric input. Code-behind applies values to AdaptiveMediaSource.AdvancedSettings.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A 'Downgrade ratio' TextBox and 'Set' button are visible
A 'Desired headroom ratio' TextBox and 'Set' button are visible
Clicking 'Set' applies the entered numeric value to the AdaptiveMediaSource.AdvancedSettings

features.name: Inbound bits per second display
features.notes: XAML verification confirms SymbolIcon Name='iconInboundBitsPerSecond' and TextBlock Name='InboundBitsPerSecondText' in Scenario4_Tuning.xaml. Controls are present but may show empty values until content is loaded and the 2-second polling timer activates.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: An inbound bitrate value is displayed with a network icon
The value updates periodically (every ~2 seconds) while content is playing
The display uses a SymbolIcon and a TextBlock showing the numeric value

features.name: Timed metadata display
features.notes: UIA confirms ContentSelector (Load Id, Load Uri, Set Source, AutoPlay), MediaPlayerElement (SeekSlider, time elements), and LogView (Copy log, Clear log, Logging level) in Scenario 5. The scenario description references HLS/DASH timed metadata. Code-behind registers TimedMetadataTracksChanged and CueEntered handlers.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: The scenario description mentions HLS and DASH timed metadata support
A ContentSelector and MediaPlayerElement are present for loading metadata-bearing streams
Metadata events (TimedMetadataTracksChanged, CueEntered) are logged in the log panel

features.name: Pre-roll, mid-roll, and post-roll ads
features.notes: UIA confirms ContentSelector and MediaPlayerElement with transport controls and LogView in Scenario 6. XAML source confirms MediaBreak-based ad insertion setup in code-behind with pre-roll, mid-roll (at 10% duration), and post-roll MediaBreakSchedule configuration.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Pre-roll ads play before the main content starts (Red Sky and Flowers videos)
Mid-roll ads play at approximately 10% into the main content
A post-roll ad plays after the main content ends
Ad playback progress events are logged in the log panel

features.name: Seekable window configuration
features.notes: UIA confirms: Text 'MaxSeekableWindowSize' (read-only, AutoId='MaxSeekableWindowSize'), Text 'DesiredSeekableWindowSize' with Button 'Set' (AutoId='DesiredSeekableWindowSizeButton'), Text 'DesiredLiveOffset' with Button 'Set' (AutoId='DesiredLiveOffsetButton'), Text 'MinLiveOffset' (read-only, AutoId='MinLiveOffset'). All 4 fields present with correct read-only/editable behavior.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: MaxSeekableWindowSize and MinLiveOffset are displayed as read-only text
DesiredSeekableWindowSize has a TextBox and 'Set' button to configure the DVR window size
DesiredLiveOffset has a TextBox and 'Set' button to configure the live offset
Values update after clicking 'Set' to reflect the applied configuration

features.name: Position slider and time display
features.notes: XAML confirms Slider x:Name='PositionSlider' Orientation='Horizontal' Width='500'. UIA confirms Text 'StartPosition' (AutoId='StartPosition'), Text 'CurrentPosition' (AutoId='CurrentPosition'), Text 'EndPosition' (AutoId='EndPosition'). Position labels show 'Start', 'Current', 'End' default values.

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: A horizontal Slider control spans the width of the content area
StartPosition, CurrentPosition, and EndPosition labels display time values
The slider position updates in real-time as the media plays
Seekable ranges update when SeekableRangesChanged event fires

features.name: Seek and playback control buttons
features.notes: UIA confirms all discrete controls: Buttons '<<15m', '<<5m', '<<30s', '<<2s', '2s>>', '30s>>', '5m>>', '15m>>' for seeking; Button 'GoToStart' (AutoId='GoToStart'), Button 'GoToLive' (AutoId='GoToLive'), Button 'Log Times' (AutoId='LogCurrentTimeCorrelation'). XAML confirms Button 'PlayButton' and 'PauseButton' with SymbolIcon Play/Pause (may be hidden until content loads).

expected_behaviour_results.bullet: Seek buttons (<<15m through 15m>>) seek forward/backward by the indicated time amount
GoToStart seeks to the beginning of the seekable range
GoToLive seeks to the end of the seekable range (live edge)
Play and Pause buttons toggle playback state and enable/disable based on current state
Log Times button logs the current time correlation data
